JouleOS: Operating-System Design Specification [E/M/S · unmetered]

Scoped explicitly as an unmetered OS architectural proposal (joules = null; core OS repo private; internal ~10^5x README aspiration unverified), with 78,400 = 280x280 Rust provenance-lattice checks.

1/2 Verified Rust spine vs prior OS lineage:
- jcp-satb-cad-spine (310 unit tests) checks all 280 x 280 provenance-tag pairs so est_j/RAPL never silently promote to shunt measured_j
- Builds on Odyssey (1999), ECOSystem (2002), Cinder (2011), Linux EAS, schedutil & RAPL [S]

2/2 Candid limits & unrun benchmarks:
- Not a shipped kernel benchmarked against Linux or seL4 on hardware wattmeters (joules = null, board_metered = false)
- Per-syscall hold/settle & Ed25519 receipt overhead risks net loss if unbatched
- Core JouleOS tree remains private

Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (human_in_gate=false; not peer-reviewed):
- Evidence: [E]/[M]/[S] · WAI1 blake3:7dc57a297246...
